final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pods sheet in boutique showed a single outlier: emailservice-5795bc6dc5-tt6tf is 0/1 (Running, Restart Count 0) while all 10 peer services are 1/1 Running. Pod events gave the mechanism verbatim: 'Warning Unhealthy 1s (x10 over 81s) kubelet Readiness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.56:8081" within 1s: context deadline exceeded'. Pod detail shows Port 8080/TCP, env PORT=8080, Liveness grpc 8080 (succeeds -> container Running, no restarts), Readiness grpc 8081 (never succeeds). GetAppYAML(emailservice) confirms readinessProbe.grpc.port=8081 while containerPort=8080 and env PORT=8080; Service emailservice port 5000 -> targetPort 8080 is consistent, so it is not a port-mapping issue. Source email_server.py binds the only gRPC server (health servicer included) to os.environ PORT (8080) via server.add_insecure_port, so nothing listens on 8081. Namespace events surface returned no Warning rows, so the fault is confined to this pod's probe config. Root cause: readiness probe configured for the wrong port, making the container permanently NotReady and leaving emailservice without ready endpoints for its caller checkoutservice.
